title: Report Templates and Branding
summary: Defines template schema, block rendering rules, branding controls, and governance lifecycle for reliable PDF output.

warning.title: IMPORTANT
paragraphs: Template changes affect future generated PDFs only. Existing generated files are not retroactively rewritten.

sections.title: Governance scope
paragraphs: Template governance is managed in `Settings -> Report Templates`. This area controls template identity, block composition order, branding, placeholder fields, and enabled state.
Only users with `manage_report_templates` can create, edit, enable, disable, reset, or delete report templates.

rows: User can select enabled templates in pentest record and call generate endpoint.
Can request `include_disabled=true` and see full template catalog.
Can delete custom templates and reset system templates to canonical.

sections.title: Template data contract
paragraphs: Backend validates template payloads before commit. Invalid keys or missing block definitions are rejected with explicit validation errors.

rows: Displayed in template pickers and admin lists.

Disabled templates are hidden from standard generation lists.
Each block must include a valid `type`.

sections.title: Supported block types and rendering behavior
paragraphs: Block order in the builder is the final render order in generated PDF output. Each block type maps to a specific renderer in `report_pdf.py`.

sections.title: Placeholders and branding rules
paragraphs: Variable tokens from record, pentest, metrics, and placeholder groups can be embedded in titles, subtitles, and text block content. Unknown tokens resolve to empty text.
Color values are interpreted as hex colors. Invalid values fall back to default report colors during render. Logo rendering expects an image path that resolves to a RAPTOR pentest image URL pattern.

tip.title: TIP
paragraphs: When using `logo_url`, prefer a value like `/pentest/images/<filename>.png`. URLs outside that pattern are ignored by the PDF image fetcher.
